first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates that shorter onboarding can improve time-to-value and early adoption. I will verify the onboarding and activation records before committing, while treating downstream qualified-revenue impact as uncertain and avoiding an immediate price response that could trade quality for volume.

final.rationale: Run a guarded standard experiment shortening onboarding, since onboarding completion is down 4% and the verified record shows the strongest downstream durability: completion +13%, time-to-value reduced by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%. Activation messaging also worked, but its activation lift is narrower and smaller on retention. Measure completion, activation, qualified pipeline/revenue, and 30-day retention to ensure improved onboarding does not increase low-quality volume.
